question: The number of protons in {}₆¹²{C} and {}₆¹⁴{C} , respectively, are:
solution:
The correct answer is __**6 and 6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The chemical notation for an element is typically represented as **AZX**, where **X** is the chemical symbol, **Z** is the **atomic number**, and **A** is the **mass number**.
 
• The **atomic number (Z)** represents the total **number of protons** present in the nucleus of an atom. Since the identity of an element is determined by its number of protons, all atoms of **Carbon** must have the same atomic number.
 
• For the isotope **¹²₆C**, the subscript **6** indicates that the **atomic number** is **6**. Therefore, it contains **6 protons**. ***Hence, the first part of the option is correct.***
